notes: Official Longse RTSP template: rtsp://{user}:{pass}@{ip}:{port}/{stream_index} where 0=main, 1=sub, 2=third stream. Port 554 is standard; exception: cameras using the Ambarella AL200 solution default to port 80 for RTSP/ONVIF/HTTP. Recorder RTSP uses a different format (port 8950, composite channel+stream encoding). The .sdp leads with credentials embedded in the path are cross-brand contamination and are excluded.
